title: Ginkgo Biloba for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Ginkgo Biloba for Hair: Mouse Research & Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: No human trial tests ginkgo biloba on hair. See what mouse studies found, and what a toxicology review says about bleeding time and allergy.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Merge target; redirected posts unsourced, nothing carried over. Old post included DIY masks and dosing; removed because unsourced.
flags: Evidence is mouse-only; stated. Li 2022 concerns a purified polysaccharide.
Chan review states 'quercetin, kaempferol and rutin have been shown to be genotoxic' (components); article says 'three of its components'.
Blood-thinner/surgery advice follows from the review's bleeding-time finding; general doctor referral.
